admission.justification: Focused blocker-reason tests verify that valid provider teardowns are not misclassified as blockers while real provider refusals never lose their diagnostic reason.

applicability: Terminal validation of provider teardown outputs (containers, networks, and provider-runtime directories).
conditions: Validation reads removed and would_remove from the provider result contract and retains producer refusal reasons on blockers.
exclusions: Reasons from non-provider terminal collections keep their own component validators.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Cleanup accepts removed provider containers, networks and runtime directories and keeps the producer's reason when removal is refused.
title: Cleanup accepts removed provider resources and keeps refusal reasons
